Agreement.description: Lawyer agreement for one agent version, over every review judged by it.
Agreement.title: Agreement

AgreementByVerdict.description:
The same figures per model verdict: `potentially_void.rate` is void precision as the
lawyer sees it.
AgreementByVerdict.title: AgreementByVerdict

AgreementCounts.description: Lawyer agreement over current decisions; `decided = kept + overridden + dismissed`.
AgreementCounts.title: AgreementCounts

AgreementOut.description: `GET /metrics/agreement`: lawyer agreement for one agent version.
AgreementOut.title: AgreementOut

ChatMessage.description:
One earlier turn of a finding's chat. The server keeps no chat history: the client
sends it back, and the server treats all of it as untrusted data.
ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage

ChatResult.description: `CUSTOM chat_result` value: the finished answer, once streaming is over.

disclaimer.default: KI-generierter Formulierungsvorschlag, keine Rechtsberatung. Bitte vor Verwendung anwaltlich prüfen.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

ChatResult.title: ChatResult

ClauseSpan.description: One clause as the splitter found it. Position is its 0-based index in the document.
ClauseSpan.title: ClauseSpan

ClauseVerdict.description: A verdict keyed by (content_hash, agent_version); shared by every document.
ClauseVerdict.title: ClauseVerdict

Decision.description: The current decision on one clause of one review (one row per review and position).
Decision.title: Decision

DecisionEvent.description:
One row of the append-only decision history (`decision_events`).

Written in the same transaction as the decision it records, never updated or deleted.
`from_*` is what was in force before (the previous decision's `decided_verdict`, or the
model's verdict and basis for the first decision), `to_*` what is in force after.
DecisionEvent.title: DecisionEvent

DecisionIn.description:
A lawyer's decision on one finding. `corrected_*` are only allowed with `override`;
an override needs `corrected_verdict`, and an empty `corrected_basis` keeps the model's §.
DecisionIn.title: DecisionIn

DecisionOut.description: `PUT /reviews/{id}/clauses/{pos}/decision`: everything the UI updates in place.
DecisionOut.title: DecisionOut

DeletionBlockedBody.description: 409 `deletion_blocked` from `DELETE /documents/{id}`: a review is still running.
DeletionBlockedBody.title: DeletionBlockedBody

DeletionReport.description: What a deletion removed (or, with `dry_run`, would remove).
DeletionReport.title: DeletionReport

DiffSegment.description:
One run of a word-level diff from the original clause to the suggestion.
Concatenating the `equal` and `delete` texts gives the original, `equal` and `insert`
the suggestion; whitespace belongs to the segment it follows.
DiffSegment.title: DiffSegment

ErasureTask.description: One outbox row: something outside the database to delete after the commit.
ErasureTask.title: ErasureTask

ErrorBody.description: Every 4xx/5xx body. `code` is stable and drives the UI's message.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

ExportBlocker.description: One finding that blocks a final export: a void or review verdict without a decision.
ExportBlocker.title: ExportBlocker

Finding.description: One clause's result inside one review: the reload path for the UI.
Finding.title: Finding

Interrupt.description: `CUSTOM` `interrupt` value: a clause now waits for the lawyer (docs/Events.md).

question.default: Das Modell ist unsicher. Bitte entscheiden Sie: Ergebnis übernehmen, ändern oder als nicht relevant verwerfen.
question.title: Question

Interrupt.title: Interrupt

MissingObligation.description: A document-level AVV finding: no clause mentions one mandatory obligation.
MissingObligation.title: MissingObligation

Obligation.description: One mandatory term of Art. 28(3)(a)-(h) DSGVO in the AVV profile.
Obligation.title: Obligation

ObligationFinding.description: The AVV agent's answer for one obligation mentioned by one clause.
ObligationFinding.title: ObligationFinding

PasteIn.description: `POST /documents` with JSON instead of multipart, for pasted text.
PasteIn.title: PasteIn

Pricing.description:
The token prices of `configs/app.yaml` (`review.price_usd_per_million_tokens`,
`review.eur_per_usd`), so the UI turns tokens into money with the server's numbers:
`usd = (input_tokens * input_usd_per_million + output_tokens * output_usd_per_million)
/ 1e6`, and `eur = usd * eur_per_usd` when the rate is set.
Pricing.title: Pricing

PrincipalOut.description: `GET /me`: who the server takes the caller to be.
PrincipalOut.title: PrincipalOut

Rect.description: One line of clause text on a page, in PDF points from the top-left corner.
Rect.title: Rect

ReviewCounts.description:
Per-review tallies, computed by `app.review.runner.count` and nowhere else.

The verdict classes count the model's verdict of every clause that has one (`done` or
`awaiting_decision`). The decision tallies count current decisions (one per clause)
on clauses with a verdict; `open_*` are those verdicts with no decision yet. The
review can be closed („Prüfung abschließen“) when `open_void == open_review == 0`.
ReviewCounts.title: ReviewCounts

ReviewSummary.description:
The summary block (8.A): deterministic from the findings and the current decisions.

`decision_set_hash` changes exactly when anything the deterministic part shows changes
(a decision, a note, a verdict); it keys the cached LLM recommendation, so the paragraph
is generated at most once per decision set. With `summary.llm_enabled` false (the
default) the recommendation is always the rule-based German text.
ReviewSummary.title: ReviewSummary

StepObservations.description: Langfuse observation ids of the steps feedback can be scored on.
StepObservations.title: StepObservations

StoredEvent.description:
One AG-UI event as persisted in `run_events` and sent as one SSE message.

`seq` starts at 1 per review and is the SSE `id`, so `Last-Event-ID: n`
resumes at `seq > n`. `payload` is the AG-UI event serialised with
`model_dump(by_alias=True, exclude_none=True)` plus `schemaVersion`.
StoredEvent.title: StoredEvent

SummaryCounts.description: What the summary block and the memo cover state, by the verdict in force.
SummaryCounts.title: SummaryCounts

SummaryFinding.description:
One finding as the summary and the export see it: the verdict *in force*.

In force means `decided_verdict(decision)` once the lawyer decided, else the model's
verdict (`finding_status == "open"`). A dismissed finding has no verdict in force and
never appears in a summary list; it is only counted.
SummaryFinding.title: SummaryFinding

SummaryGroup.description:
Void findings that share the statute paragraph of their strongest § in force.

The paragraph is that of the first chunk of `SummaryFinding.basis` (`LawChunk.law` and
`LawChunk.paragraph`), so § 309 Nr. 7 and § 309 Nr. 8 fall in one group "§ 309 BGB".
Findings without a basis form one group, `key = label = SUMMARY_NO_BASIS`.
SummaryGroup.title: SummaryGroup

Tombstone.description:
What the audit trail keeps of a deletion: who deleted what, when and why, and how
many rows went; no content (no filename, no clause text, no note). Append-only.
Tombstone.title: Tombstone
